claims.question: q1
claims.claim: Palantir originated forward-deployed engineering around 2006; its senior engineers called Deltas embed with customers for 6 to 18 months to put Foundry and AIP into production and feed lessons back into software.
claims.quote: Palantir originated forward-deployed engineering around 2006. Its senior engineers ("Deltas") embed with government and enterprise customers for 6 to 18 months to put Foundry and AIP into production, and fold what they learn back into the software.

claims.question: q1
claims.claim: Each Delta is paired with an Echo deployment strategist; engagements run through Acquire, Expand, and Scale phases, with Palantir absorbing pilot costs, developing use cases at a loss, then reaching positive contribution margin.
claims.quote: Each Delta works with an Echo, a strategist who maps institutional politics, barriers to adoption and executive alignment. Engagements run in three phases: Acquire, where Palantir absorbs pilot costs; Expand, where the two sides develop use cases together at a loss to Palantir; and Scale, where the account reaches positive contribution margin.

claims.question: q1
claims.claim: In Q2 2026, Palantir reported net dollar retention of 157% and closed 73 deals worth at least $10M.
claims.quote: The expansion shows: net dollar retention was 157% in Q2 2026, when Palantir closed 73 deals worth at least $10M.

claims.question: q1
claims.claim: AIP Bootcamps are short pilots on prospects' own data; by February 2024 Palantir had run more than 560 across 465 organizations, exceeding its goal of 500 within a year.
claims.quote: AIP Bootcamps are short pilots built on a prospect's own data; Palantir calls them its go-to-market approach for AIP. By February 2024 it had run more than 560 across 465 organizations, past its goal of 500 within a year.

claims.question: q3
claims.claim: Palantir uses custom contracts with no published list prices, charging for multi-year software subscriptions, usage-based compute and storage, and FDE services bundled into early-phase costs and absorbed upfront rather than billed by time and materials.
claims.quote: Custom contracts with no published list prices, built from three charges: multi-year software subscriptions for platform access; usage-based compute and storage fees; and forward-deployed engineering services, bundled into early-phase contract costs and absorbed upfront rather than billed by time and materials.

claims.question: q4
claims.claim: Palantir's Foundry centers on an Ontology defined as a semantic representation of an organization's data, logic, and actions that ties raw data to live operations.
claims.quote: Foundry handles enterprise data integration, workflow orchestration and AI deployment, centered on the Ontology, a semantic representation of an organization's data, logic and actions that ties raw data to live operations.

claims.question: q5
claims.claim: A 2025 MIT study found 95% of enterprise AI pilots fail to deliver business value; Palantir argues its bootcamps and FDE engagements put working prototypes on real customer data from day one.
claims.quote: A 2025 MIT study found 95% of enterprise AI pilots fail to deliver business value; Palantir's Bootcamps and forward-deployed engagements put working prototypes on real customer data from day one.

claims.question: q2
claims.claim: Fujitsu signed a new AIP and Foundry agreement and became a Global Forward Deployed Engineering Partner on Sep 10, 2026.
claims.quote: Fujitsu signed a new AIP and Foundry agreement and became a Global Forward Deployed Engineering Partner (Sep 10, 2026)
